basic_details.organization_name: Indian Institute of Management Jammu (IIM Jammu)
basic_details.short_information: Indian Institute of Management Jammu (IIM Jammu) has published the Medical Officer Notification 2026 under Advertisement No. IIMJ/Advt/Non-Faculty-Rect/2026/02 on its official website, https://www.iimj.ac.in/. The recruitment drive aims to fill 2 Medical Officer positions on a contractual basis. Candidates up to 45 years of age with an M.B.B.S. degree securing at least 60% marks, completion of compulsory rotatory internship, and registration with the Indian/State Medical Council are eligible to apply. qualification.details: M.B.B.S. with at least 60% marks including completion of compulsory rotatory internship from Indian University/ Institutes. Registered with Indian/State Doctors Bodies. how_to_apply: Applications must be submitted online on or before 11-08-2026.
To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section.
Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of IIM Jammu to complete the application.
Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details.
Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format.
Pay the application fee online, if applicable.
Review all details carefully before submitting the form.
Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

content_sections.heading: IIM Jammu Medical Officer Recruitment 2026 - Overview
IIM Jammu Medical Officer Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates should download and read the IIM Jammu Jobs 2026 notification PDF carefully to check vacancy details, eligibility, age limit, and application instructions. The notification also includes important dates and selection process details. The direct download link is available in the Important Links section below. Download IIM Jammu Medical Officer Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: A total of 2 vacancies are available – 2 for the Medical Officer post.

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: M.B.B.S. with at least 60% marks including completion of compulsory rotatory internship from Indian University/ Institutes. Registered with Indian/State Doctors Bodies. Desirable: M.D. or equivalent PG Medical qualifications in any branch of Medicine with at least 60% marks with experience post-PG.

content_sections.heading: Age Limit
content_sections.text: Maximum Age Limit: 45 years Age relaxation for retired doctors from Departments, Undertakings, and authorities under Government of India may apply. Age up to 65 Years may apply. The consolidated salary will be fixed as per Government of India Rules i.e. last pay drawn minus pension plus other perks and benefits as per Government of India Rules.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Applications must be submitted online on or before 11-08-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of IIM Jammu to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIM Jammu Medical Officer recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application form for the IIM Jammu Medical Officer recruitment is 11-08-2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Medical Officer post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies available for the Medical Officer post at IIM Jammu.

faq.question: Q3. What is the required qualification for the Medical Officer position?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an M.B.B.S. degree with at least 60% marks and completion of compulsory rotatory internship. Registration with Indian/State Doctors Bodies is mandatory. An M.D. or equivalent PG Medical qualification is desirable.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for applying to this post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Medical Officer post is 45 years. Age relaxation is applicable for retired doctors from Government of India departments.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Medical Officer role?
faq.answer: The salary offered for the Medical Officer position is Rs. 56,100 - 177,500 Per Month on a consolidated contract basis.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for General/OBC candidates?
faq.answer: The application fee for General and OBC candidates is Rs. 590/-.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for SC/ST candidates?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for SC/ST candidates.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the IIM Jammu Medical Officer recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Medical Officer recruitment will be based on a Personal Interview.

faq.question: Q9. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process for the IIM Jammu Medical Officer recruitment is entirely online.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and apply online?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF and the online application link can be found in the "Important Links" section of this article.
